Ricardo, Inc. is the US arm of Ricardo, a propulsion and vehicle engineering firm, based at the Detroit Technical Center in Van Buren Township, Michigan. Established in 1989 and a member of WSP Global since 2025, it provides engineering design, test and validation, and niche manufacturing across combustion, hybrid, electric, and hydrogen powertrains for automotive OEMs and suppliers.
Ownership
Investing $24.1 million and adding at least 114 jobs at its Van Buren Township site for a new engine manufacturing line, announced 2026.
Ownership and history

Ricardo, Inc. was established in 1989 and has operated in Southeast Michigan for more than 35 years. It is the US subsidiary of Ricardo, an engineering firm founded in 1915 by Sir Harry Ricardo as Engine Patents Limited and long headquartered in Shoreham-by-Sea, England. That heritage, more than a century of combustion and propulsion engineering, is central to how the company positions itself.
